description: Subject categories for projects and visual styles. Single source of truth: brief.json `categories`, style records `categories` and series.json `categories` are validated against these ids. A project may carry more than one (for example history + finance). To add a category, add it here; nothing else needs to change.

categories.name: Technology & software
categories.description: Software, systems, engineering, how technical things work.

categories.name: Science & research
categories.description: Natural science, medicine, studies and research findings.

categories.name: History
categories.description: Past events, people, places and periods.

categories.name: Mathematics
categories.description: Proofs, structures, patterns and quantitative ideas.

categories.name: News
categories.description: Current events and explainers on them.

categories.name: Storytelling
categories.description: Narrative-first pieces where story, character or mood leads over explanation.
